assertions.assert: It takes the `<param>` `routines` `[{name, source}]` (`source` the path of the routine's program, decision D121) and runs the first routine as its child `routine` (`<invoke srcexpr>` on its source); on start it sends nothing of its own, and it never reaches a final state.
Each `bot.behavior.tick` its routine sends it goes to its parent unchanged, once.
With more than one routine it invokes itself (`rest`) with the rest of the routines, so every routine runs and each tick of the chain reaches the parent once, whatever its depth.
A tick whose `name` is none of the chain's routines' names is stale and not forwarded.
A routine that ends (`done.invoke.routine`) stays stopped, and the rest keep running.
A routine whose program does not compile (`error.execution` in the runner) stays stopped, logged `routines.failed` `<name> (error.execution)`, and the rest keep running.
A tick the routine sends whose data its schema rejects never reaches the runner (`error.execution` in the routine) and is not forwarded; the routine's later ticks are.
